notes.title: Origins DLC - Quick Patch #1

Happy shooting!

notes.title: Preparing for the Release 10.10.2022
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/0bfcdf125c64ba7a3cd082f7168bd6528bed8f49.jpg

Soldiers!
It's been a long time since WW2: Bunker Simulator EA launched. 
The game in September 2021 was vastly different, unfinished in some cases, product.
We've listened to you guys (big thanks for the support from our Discord, without you the game wouldn't be the same! <3) and worked hard. 

Here is a brief list of things added in EA:
- improvements to enemy AI 
- MG companion balance 
- Overall MG rework
- Utility orders (taking the rubble out and finishing the sandbags projects)
- Companion Healing and HP tunning
- Companion Thirst, Hunger, and Energy
- bunker doors mechanic
- mines field and mechanics improvements
- anti-tank gun improvement
- special Halloween Event
- special Christmas Event
- audio improvements
- additional save slots
- new tutorial
- key bindings
- trash can for useless items/ingredients
- looting enemy ammo from the weapon
- inventory improvement (assigning items to hotkeys by hoovering; slot scrolling, shift information)
- companion marker
- enemy body disappear after looting (for less powerful PCs)


After all this introduction...
We proudly announce that WW2: Bunker Simulator will leave Early Access on the 10th of October!

notes.title: Quick patch #5
WW2: Bunker Simulator - Christmas Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/b40da8d37f2d1e6b9cb0dfc5109541f3dc4ac02a.png
MERRY CHRISTMAS SOLDIERS!
Celebrate this special time of the year in your bunker!

We prepared a special Christmas event for this occasion.
Dress up your freshly delivered conifer which you can find it in your room (you have time till the December 31st), prepare the letter and receive wonderful gifts!
All of that while eating delicious candy canes and with snow melting on your helmet.

The Word is that goblins in your area have loads of Xmass decorations in their possession. 
They surely won't mind if you'll borrow some from them (what will the dead goblin need Christmas tree decorations for?)

Gifts are coming between the December 31st and January 9th!
Santa Claus is open for every request so you can write him a letter - the paper is on your bedside table. 
But beware, if you want to receive what you wish for, your Xmass tree needs to be fully dressed up till December 31st! 
If it won't be ready you'll get only one gift with random trash inside.

What you waiting for, 
grab your gun, 
kill some stinky goblins, 
loot the snowman, 
decorate the Christmas tree, 
write the letter 
and Ho Ho Ho!
Merry Christmas!



cheers,
Bunker Dev Team

notes.title: WW2: Bunker Simulator - Early Access Christmas update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/ac8c0c37415157846bd275b9d44576fe521ca3b3.png

Soldiers!

Christmas and winter time is coming... 

So first Christmas thanks to all PLAYERS for the great support!!
Another week - another progress - another update is under way.
We would like to show you some respect for being with us thus some Xmas aspects are scheduled :-)


December is a special month, christmas is coming, you can expect snow in some areas of the world, Santa Claus might visit those who behaved polite, christmas tree with all decorations has its own place in every house. So we thought - why Bunker should be different than any other place?

Ultimately we are behind the enemy lines which means we are still exists on Earth :-)
So all the seasoned worldwide events applies. Thus have we landed on this winter brilliant idea - let's prepare some Christmas event in the Bunker.
Lonely soldier, far away from home deserves to feel family friendly atmosphere. Especially being under attack and constantly struggling to survive without any relatives support.
Making hot tea - sure! But within next couple of minutes enemy enters the Bunker. It is not fair for our soldier. He needs some positive energy in December :-)

Christmas items - yes!
Christmas monster - yes!
Christmas atmosphere - yes!
Christmas present - yes!
Christmas everything- yes!


So... Stay tuned for the next week hotfix on Friday 17th December.


cheers,
Bunker Dev Team

notes.title: Halloween Update v2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/8c7794d8747e8bd46a5dd88947cff6d3359801ab.png

SOLDIERS!
After tough battles with pumpkinheads and zombies, you will receive support. At the same time, be warned, the zombie hour has come.

The second version of the Halloween update supplements our event with new functionalities.

What’s new?

 Candies in the opponents bodies - they give you energy to make it easier to get through the long nights
 Pumpkin bombs. You can find them in the opponents bodies. They work like grenades, but are more powerful and have a longer range.
 Scythe - the Boss Butcher often has it with him. You can also find the scythe by searching the mummies. The scythe can come in handy when fighting zombies. Has a slightly greater range than the ax and deals more damage.
 Instead of birds, bats fly at night.
 Night animal sounds,

All the things you’ll earn during Halloween will stay with you!

QOL Halloween

 More, more zombies.
 Pumpkinheads no longer laugh after being killed by grenades.
 When the zombie enters the bunker, you will hear an alarm sound.
 When the boss butcher goes to the bunker, in addition to the health bar, a warning message will appear on the screen.


QOL global game

 ACHTUNG! During missions with infantry, enemies can launch an attack at the back of the bunker. Be cautious :)
 We've slightly reduced the drop of pills in enemy bodies.
 In response to your feedback, you may occasionally receive 1 mission to complete during the day. This will give you more time to manage your resources and prepare for the fight in the coming days.
 Gewehr will be more accurate.
 Localization corrections.


Still based on your feedback, we are trying to fine-tune the game balance. 

If in your opinion the game is too difficult, too easy or you get too much of the items, please visit our DISCORD server. We welcome any feedback and often take it into account in future updates.


Feel free to join our DISCORD server:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/75fc285aa7879bdfdae914b03e05558bc380dd67.jpg

notes.title: Status update and Gameplay
notes.notes:
We are happy to say we are close to announcing the release date of our game. Before we do so, we want to make sure that game mechanics are balanced and we properly tested and debugged everything, so we need some more time to polish the gameplay.

The game runs fine right now, but we need to put some more work into enemy AI as they can be either too easy or too difficult, depending on the situation. We are intensively testing survival mechanics as well.
Below is some gameplay from the Air Drop mission mentioned 
in this Devlog.
You will be able to see how the bunker looks outside as well :)

[previewyoutube=0BNgQ4tAZ1E;full]https://youtu.be/0BNgQ4tAZ1E[/previewyoutube]

Thank you so much for being so patient! If You haven't done this yet, there is a free demo to check out on our Steam Page.

Best regards,
WW2 Bunker Simulator Team
